description:
Activate a basic land by tapping it, adding {1}.
Activate Earthcraft by tapping Reckless Racer, targeting the basic land.
Reckless Racer triggers, causing you to rummage.
Tolarian Kraken triggers, causing you to pay {1} to untap Reckless Racer.
Resolve the Earthcraft ability, untapping the basic land.
Repeat.
